<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="acheron-mammoths" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Acheron Mammoths</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Acheron mammoths are one of the 4 raptor mobs and have the highest HP of the bunch. Although they give decent slayer XP, they don't drop any rare uniques and thus are the least popular of the raptor creatures. They attack with melee and ranged, with their ranged attack having the animation of throwing a ice ball. This attack is dodge-able always hits if it lands, dealing moderately heavy ranged damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="stats"><nowiki>Stats</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per kill : 4215.6</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~375 (High Effort), 290 (Low Effort)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per hour : ~1.58M (High effort), 1.22M (Low effort)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="desirable-drops"><nowiki>Desirable Drops</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Guaranteed unique drop every kill of a Mammoth Tusk, which is an ingredient in making Pack Mammoth </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1499293961364308059.png?v=1" alt="mammothpouch" title="mammothpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> pouches.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ In addition to this, they have a rich drop table, making the tasks decent for GP alongside XP. Mammoths also provide a large amount of crimson and blue charms, dropping 4 at a time.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="location-and-how-to-get-there"><nowiki>Location and How to Get There</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Mammoths can be found in 2 locations:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>The Mammoth Iceberg</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - Accessible via a boat to the north of the Fremennik Lodestone.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ This location is used if </nowiki><strong><nowiki>AoE slaying actively</nowiki></strong><nowiki> due to having more spawns.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Methods to get there (fastest to slowest): Fairy Ring </nowiki><strong><nowiki>D K S</nowiki></strong><nowiki> &gt; Fremennik lode &gt; Fremennik boots teleport</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Frozen Waste Plateau</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ This location is used if slaying Mammoths </nowiki><strong><nowiki>low effort</nowiki></strong><nowiki> due to it benefiting from </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189299681607800.png?v=1" alt="infernalpuzzlebox" title="infernalpuzzlebox" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006121672790773770.png?v=1" alt="jasboost" title="jasboost" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Teleport there using the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Ice Plateau teleport</nowiki></strong><nowiki> (Lunar spellbook).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="mechanics"><ins><nowiki>Mechanics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>



</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Freedom</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ When stunned for bound, mammoths will shout 'Freedom!' and remove any stuns and binds. This does not clear bleeds.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Dishonourable conduct</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ When </nowiki><strong><nowiki>damaged out of melee distance</nowiki></strong><nowiki> of the player, the mammoth may fling 3 ice balls at the player, each dealing heavy ranged damage. Getting hit will disable all prayers, drain all run energy, and bind the player.
    • This is the mechanic with by far the highest kill potential. Try to keep in melee distance when attacking mammoths at all costs.
    • It is suicidal to use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1" alt="cannon" title="cannon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to aggro mammoths due to this mechanic.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Charge</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ The mammoth shakes and a blue bar above its head starts filling up. When the bar fills, the mammoth does 1-3 charges, pushing the player and dealing heavy melee damage each charge.
    • To avoid this, simply pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMelee" title="DeflectMelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and allow it to hit you, or move out of the way.
    • If being attacked by more than 1 mammoth, the displacement from this attack may trigger </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Dishonourable conduct</nowiki></strong><nowiki> from another mammoth, which can easily kill the player.
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>

<nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>



</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Items</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Dominion_mine <strong><nowiki>Dominion Mines</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1" alt="dommine" title="dommine" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Useful for doing Mammoths actively.
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Magic_notepaper <strong><nowiki>Magic notepaper</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137735230908805240.png?v=1" alt="notepaper" title="notepaper" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Useful for noting mammoth tusks for extra GP.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Passives/Unlocks</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Stone_of_Jas_(status) <strong><nowiki>Stone of Jas buff</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006121672790773770.png?v=1" alt="jasboost" title="jasboost" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Damage boost to mammoths in the wilderness.
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Infernal_Puzzle_Box <strong><nowiki>Infernal Puzzle box</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189299681607800.png?v=1" alt="infernalpuzzlebox" title="infernalpuzzlebox" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Damage boost to mammoths in the wilderness.
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Aggression <strong><nowiki>Aggression</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/909338509234569216.png?v=1" alt="aggression" title="aggression" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Useful for pulling spawns to AoE.
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="method-active-melee"><ins><nowiki>Method: Active Melee</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Melee is the best method for mammoths, as you need to be in melee distance as much as possible due to </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Dishonourable conduct</nowiki></strong><nowiki>. Additionally, melee has abundant AoE which hits around the player, making it perfect for killing multiple mammoths as you want to position in the middle of mammoths as much as possible.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="presets-and-relics"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=429f11b1-df4e-4f1a-aa34-f6c37dc7a151 <nowiki>Melee - Active</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F429f11b1-df4e-4f1a-aa34-f6c37dc7a151.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="strategy"><nowiki>Strategy</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Set up your coil as shown below between the 2 rocks and exposed rib skeleton. Stay in this general vicinity to kill the 4 spawns boxed in yellow.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/L47xyt0ZBA.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use lossless healing food such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690140078407680059.png?v=1" alt="supergrest" title="supergrest" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689530593742291033.png?v=1" alt="blueblubber" title="blueblubber" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to keep HP up, along with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641337999170207763.png?v=1" alt="excal" title="excal" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ The general rotation is </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879359377439.png?v=1" alt="meteorstrike" title="meteorstrike" kind="icon" /><nowiki> after </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> ends → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626465964325601290.png?v=1" alt="zgs" title="zgs" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> ASAP</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Lay </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1" alt="dommine" title="dommine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> every time </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879359377439.png?v=1" alt="meteorstrike" title="meteorstrike" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is used.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1" alt="tuskas" title="tuskas" kind="icon" /><nowiki> under </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1279516151423963166.png?v=1" alt="critbuff" title="critbuff" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for more adren.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use excess adrenaline on </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409589261238282.png?v=1" alt="dragonhalberd" title="dragonhalberd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Sip </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1" alt="adrenrenewal" title="adrenrenewal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> when using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This video uses an suboptimal </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651387613194.png?v=1" alt="oldakcoil" title="oldakcoil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> positioning.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="method-low-effort-melee"><ins><nowiki>Method: Low effort Melee</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>There's no completely safe method to AFK killing mammoths due to their charge attack. However, players can utilise the Wilderness which is less densely populated with spawns, of which there are several spots that guarantees getting attacked by at most 2 mammoths at once.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This method uses the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903893177106454.png?v=1" alt="lanispear" title="lanispear" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, a cheap weapon which exploits mammoths' stab weakness, allowing you to not splash through their high defences even with no aura.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• BIS perks are not needed, and using one the player may own for killing </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/789813907706478603.png?v=1" alt="raksha" title="raksha" kind="icon" /><nowiki> will suffice.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="presets-and-relics_1"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=9e6db227-52fa-4fd3-8f18-db16d54f37f1 <nowiki>Melee - Low Effort</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F9e6db227-52fa-4fd3-8f18-db16d54f37f1.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="strategy_1"><nowiki>Strategy</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Set up your </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651405438997.png?v=1" alt="kineticcyclone" title="kineticcyclone" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as shown below between the trees.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/eo4XgVJkSZ.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Click mammoths to start kills as sometimes mammoths will take a while to start their first attack despite being hit by the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651405438997.png?v=1" alt="kineticcyclone" title="kineticcyclone" kind="icon" /><nowiki> multiple times, which increases the time your character stands idle.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Manually casting </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455640215633.png?v=1" alt="overpowerigneous" title="overpowerigneous" kind="icon" /><nowiki> when not in </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on mammoths with more than 20k HP left improves this method significantly.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>

<h3 id="revo-bar"><nowiki>Revo bar</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/cTHCb9toyb.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
